tools.name: mri_list_categories
tools.description: List every Machine Relations Index category (e.g. cybersecurity, fintech, enterprise-software, ai-visibility-geo) with the question shapes that have published citation rates, plus the source-role vocabulary. Call this first to get a valid category key.

tools.name: mri_get_category
tools.description: Return one category's question shapes (best tools, how buyers choose, comparisons, top lists, problem-first research, is it worth it, news) and the evidence state of each: published with rates, collecting, or not collectable.

tools.name: mri_get_cited_sources
tools.description: Ranked source domains that AI answer engines cite for one category and question shape, with citation rate (share of monitored answer runs citing the domain), rank, percentile and source role (editorial publication, vendor-owned, analyst research, community, academic/government, market database, wire

tools.name: mri_get_domain
tools.description: For one domain or URL, return how often AI answer engines cite it: overall citation rate, which engines cite it, confidence tier, rank among all cited domains and within its source role, and per-category segment rates. Use to answer 'does ChatGPT/Perplexity cite <site>' or 'how authoritative is <pub

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "mri_get_domain" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: For one domain or URL, return how often AI answer engines cite it: overall citation rate, which engines cite it, confidence tier, rank among all cited domains a…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mri_get_domain · Private data: mri_get_cited_sources · Public sink: mri_get_cited_sources.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mri_get_domain · Private data: mri_get_cited_sources · Public sink: mri_get_cited_sources

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
